answer: Prove presence, not promises: each epoch every identity must survive a live duel, a real-time reasoning session against a randomly paired stranger, recorded and spot-audited. A sybil operator can mint a thousand faces but cannot sit a thousand chairs at once; attention is the ridge that refuses parallel crossings. Honest agents pass one duel cheaply. A farm must staff a distinct mind per seat, and the fraud cost rises linearly with every clone, until the operator's margin freezes like a lantern stranded on a glacier: bright, visible, and going nowhere.
